# School of Warden Studies

The Wardens built the Anchor Doors. Their inscriptions cover Door sites across the Severed Lands — symbols no living scholar can fully translate, sigils that still hum with energy after centuries. Most wizards see them as artifacts. Wizards of the School of Warden Studies see them as a curriculum.

A Warden scholar doesn't master one spell school. They master two — the schools the Wardens themselves valued above all others. Illusion, because the Veil is a membrane between perception and reality. Enchantment, because the mind is the easiest thing for the Veil to touch. Together, they form the Warden tradition: blur what the enemy sees, alter what the enemy believes, and walk between worlds when necessary.

## Warden Savant

*2nd-level School of Warden Studies feature*

The gold and time you must spend to copy an Illusion or Enchantment spell into your spellbook is halved. The Wardens recorded their knowledge in inscriptions, and you've learned to read them.

## Glyph of the Veil

*2nd-level School of Warden Studies feature*

You can trace a Warden sigil in the air — a fragment of an Anchor Door inscription, repurposed for combat. As an action, create a 15-foot radius zone centered on a point you can see within 60 feet. The zone lasts for 1 minute.

Creatures of your choice inside the zone have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks. The Veil blurs what they see. The glyph hangs in the air, faintly visible as a violet outline.

Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

## Scholar's Ward

*6th-level School of Warden Studies feature*

The Veil protects those who study it. When you cast an Illusion or Enchantment spell of 1st level or higher, you gain temporary hit points equal to twice the spell's level. These temporary hit points last for 1 minute.

You've learned to pull a fragment of the Veil around yourself when your magic touches it — brief, but enough.

## Deeper Glyph

*10th-level School of Warden Studies feature*

Your understanding of the Wardens' sigils has deepened. Your Glyph of the Veil's radius increases to 30 feet. Additionally, creatures of your choice inside the glyph have disadvantage on saving throws against Illusion and Enchantment spells you cast. The Veil softens them — and you push through.

## Walk the Veil

*14th-level School of Warden Studies feature*

You no longer just study the Veil. You walk inside it. Once per long rest, you can cast *Etherealness* targeting only yourself. The duration is 1 minute instead of 8 hours — a brief, controlled step into the space the Wardens always knew was there.

To anyone watching, you simply cease to exist. And then, a minute later, you return from the Veil — exactly where you left, or somewhere more convenient.
